method: Actual exported USDZ imported through Apple SceneKit and two rendered PNGs visually inspected; no geometry/image correction.
findings: The result does not have a recognizable usable chair silhouette.
The seat is a vertical thin plate: dimensions width=0.45,height=0.45,depth=0.02 instead of a thin horizontal seat.
Four named legs share the same position and size; they are not four separated supports.
The model emitted extra backrest_attach/leg*_attach/attach2 geometry nodes instead of consistently using placement relationships.
Actual height is 2.316m; the requested seat height is about0.45m.
nextControlledProbe: Change only grammar property order to required-first so node id/primitive precede dimensions and dimensions follow width,height,depth. Same model, prompt, limits and authoritative schema. This is a hypothesis, not an accepted quality fix.
scope: Improved syntax/completeness does not count as general modeling acceptance.
